revenue.source: Verizon 10-K FY2023/FY2024/FY2025 (FY2025 10-K, 4Q25 earnings release exhibit 99, acc. 0000732712-26-000003); stockanalysis.com income statement

operating_income.source: GAAP operating income: FY2023 22,877 and FY2024 28,686 from Verizon 2Q25 financial operating info; FY2025 32,160 from FY2025 10-K summary (TradingView). Note stockanalysis shows adjusted 30,186/30,899/31,648; FY2023 includes 5,841 Business goodwill impairment

d_and_a.source: Verizon 10-K FY2025 consolidated income statement (D&A expense 18,349 / 17,892 / 17,624)

capex.source: Cash flow statement capital expenditures incl. capitalized software, per stockanalysis.com (FY2025 17.0bn confirmed in Verizon 4Q25 release)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 2.5%, FY2024 0.6%; mature wireless/broadband with low-single-digit growth fading toward GDP-like rates; no M&A (e.g. Frontier) explicitly modeled

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 GAAP margin 23.3% (32,160/138,191); held roughly flat, excludes one-off impairments

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximate US federal 21% plus state, in line with Verizon's recent effective rate range of ~21-23%

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 actual 17,011/138,191 = 12.3%; held flat, consistent with ~$17bn run-rate

wacc.source: Assumption: low-beta telecom (~0.4-0.6), Rf ~4.2%, ERP ~5% giving ~6.5-7% cost of equity blended with ~85% debt-heavy capital structure at after-tax cost ~4.5%; rounded 6.5%

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run nominal GDP and below Rf; mature telecom industry

net_debt.source: FY2025 (Dec 31, 2025) balance sheet per stockanalysis.com: current portion of LT debt 17,675 + long-term debt 141,135 (excl. leases) - cash 19,048; no short-term investments

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares FY2025, millions, per stockanalysis.com income statement (basic 4,226 per Verizon 4Q25 release)
